# H0 finite design examples

Hand-authored in this session on 2026-10-19 from the owned native contract and H0 proposal; no external corpus, measured output, model response or copied implementation. `coordination.json` uses synthetic nonsecret IDs and zero real effects. It is not a public API, snapshot version or admitted resource profile.

The test-only oracle in `tests/system/harness-design.test.mjs` checks a single assumed issued namespace/authority-epoch context, at most four launches and sixteen stream observations, independent per-stream offsets, one pinned dependency evidence selection, and queued first-write fencing after an acknowledged takeover. It assumes the namespace/connection is already authenticated and does not test namespace issuance, authorization, durable admission, in-flight writes, partial delivery, cancellation, scheduler fairness, real parser/modes, process/PTY behavior or model mediation. The input fixture's two parallel same-task launches and separate dependency example are finite relationships, not the complete producer/consumer journey or a real E2E trace.

The original criterion counts are 2:3, 17:3, 18:3, 19:3, 20:3, 21:3, 23:4 and 4:5, from the original acceptance sections retained in those GitHub issues. The row-coverage assertion detects missing/duplicated IDs only; it cannot validate a disposition's truth or owner acceptance. Actual coverage requires the independent source/evidence review recorded with the proposal revision.

Run with the pinned Node: `node --test tests/system/harness-design.test.mjs`. Future runtime traces/oracles require independent review and should not be generated from the implementation under test. Keep these design checks distinguishable from unchanged historical X4/EA1 FAIL evidence and from executable runtime qualification.
